acceptanceCriteria: Decision recorded (reuse, refuse with a code, or ordinary handling) in the spec with a requirement ID.
Focused test pins the chosen behavior.
body: Found by lane V1-1547 (claim --detach, PR beamfall/corvint#1015, head 01eae41a5, base 8fa297eae, corvint build 615) on 2026-10-17. Open question: when a holder that already has a live attempt runs claim --detach with a different request id, ordinary claim handling applies (a second attempt or collision). Owner decision needed: should --detach reuse/refuse instead?
title: Detached claim by a holder with a live attempt under a different request id
